plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Deployed in shadow on openvibe-ovh: /opt/openvibe.billing (release b59725e), unit openvibe-billing, API on 127.0.0.1:4600 (loopback only; /api/v1 is denied on the public host). Public at https://billing.openvibe.network: the staff console (Network SSO + PKCE, BILLING_STAFF_SUBJECTS = the owner only), /api/health and /webhooks/*. No provider secret is configured, so every provider is off and /webhooks/* answers 404 billing.provider_disabled. Pins openvibe-contracts v0.19.0.
notes: Runtime, journal, adapters, import, reconciliation and the staff console (cashout approve/deny, review queue, reconciliation, freeze, audit log) are built and tested. Capabilities (8 billing.*) and events are registered in OpenVibe.Contracts (v0.8.0; billing.staff.action in v0.17.0). Production holds a shadow import of a Live snapshot (322 transactions: 304 imported plus 18 opening adjustments; 3 reconciliation runs, the last 2026-09-23 01:21 UTC, all checks ok), 0 subscriptions and 0 entitlements; the console has never been used (staff_audit 0). The restore drill passed on the host 2026-09-23 05:22 UTC. The Live side (Billing client behind BILLING_AUTHORITY, money freeze) is deployed in Live since c384787, but BILLING_AUTHORITY is not set in live.env, so Live stays the money authority. The cutover (README runbook, docs/live-cutover.md) has not been executed: it waits on the owner putting the PowerChat secret in billing.env and re-pointing the PowerChat webhook to https://billing.openvibe.network/webhooks/powerchat. Not done: /metrics (404), scheduled reconciliation, EXTERNAL PowerChat tips produce no event for Tips, payouts/refunds/plans are represented by cashouts, refund transactions and VIP plans rather than their own tables.
